registry_correction: Registry 'Income tax law (federal); little accessible law; USD widely used' replaced: the Federal Government enacted a new Income Tax Law (No. 37, 11 May 2025) with a resident scale in US dollars: 0 % to $1,200, 6 % to $6,000, 12 % to $18,000, 18 % above (printed fixed amount $1,788 at $18,000); under-18 residents 20 % flat; non-residents 18 % flat.
